# volcano_project (Data Source)

Look up a single Volcano project by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "volcano_project" "example" {
  id = "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Project UUID.

### Read-Only

- `all_regions` (Boolean)
- `created_at` (String)
- `logo_url` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `plan` (String)
- `selected_regions` (List of String)
- `status` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
